definitions.explanation: A large natural elevation of the earth's surface.
A large amount of something stacked up.
The most intense or crucial point.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}が{山|やま}のようにある。
{富士山|ふじさん}は{日本|にほん}で{一番|いちばん}{高|たか}い{山|やま}です。
examples.english: Mt. Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}に{山|やま}でキャンプをしました。
examples.english: I camped in the mountains in summer.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{空気|くうき}は{気持|きも}ちがいいです。
{遠|とお}くに{山|やま}が{見|み}えます。
examples.english: I can see mountains in the distance.

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}に{本|ほん}の{山|やま}がある。
examples.english: There's a pile of books on the desk.

examples.japanese: {洗濯物|せんたくもの}が{山|やま}のようにたまっている。
examples.english: The laundry has piled up like a mountain.

examples.japanese: {宿題|しゅくだい}が{山|やま}ほどある。
{ゴミ|ごみ}の{山|やま}になっていた{部屋|へや}を{掃除|そうじ}した。
examples.english: I cleaned the room that had become a pile of garbage.

examples.japanese: {物語|ものがたり}は{ここ|ここ}から{山|やま}に{入|はい}る。
examples.english: The story reaches its climax from here.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}の{山|やま}は{後半|こうはん}だった。
examples.english: The climax of the match was in the second half.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}の{山|やま}を{越|こ}えた。
examples.english: We got past the critical point of the illness.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{山|やま}を{越|こ}えたので、{少|すこ}し{楽|らく}になった。
examples.english: I got past the busiest period at work, so things got a little easier.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{山|やま}は{最後|さいご}の30{分|ぷん}です。
examples.english: The climax of the movie is the last 30 minutes.

notes:
{山|やま} means mountain.

EXPRESSIONS:
- {山|やま}を{張|は}る: to make a guess, to speculate
- {山|やま}を{越|こ}える: to get over the worst
- {山|やま}ほど: a lot, mountains of

COMPOUNDS:
- {富士山|ふじさん}: Mt. Fuji
- {火山|かざん}: volcano
- {登山|とざん}: mountain climbing
- {山道|やまみち}: mountain path
